headline: Congress named a federal courthouse in Oklahoma City after retired judge William J. Holloway, Jr.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. courthouse at 200 NW 4th Street in Oklahoma City as the William J. Holloway, Jr. United States Courthouse. It does not change how the court works, what cases it hears, or any rules that apply to people. It is an honorary name change.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on October 7, 2015.
